While the broader study involves genetic perturbations (siRNA depletion of TNRC6), those were validated via RT-qPCR and luciferase assays, not the primary LC-MS/MS dataset described in the PRIDE metadata and the LFQ section of the text. The primary MS variable is the presence/absence of the miR-122 ligand/factor.
